name: created-then-removed-assertion-scope
body: Two limits. (1) The save's `no pending changes` report is written to the coordinator process's stdout while the client reply is the fixed `Session saved`, so the no-op is pinned by durable state (no node file, no commit, empty ledger, no dirty row, absent read) and not by wording; upgrade if the message itself must ever be pinned — capture the session process's stdout — but this test should stay state-based even then. (2) The "no dirty row" read is scoped to the `Requirement` table, the only table this fixture's mutations touch, not the whole durable roster; widen it if a later task makes this test admit mutations on more than one node table.
